title: The green arrow means the whole demand curve moves

steps.title: What the green arrow means
steps.say: The green arrow is not a movement along the curve. It shows that the whole demand curve shifts to the right.

ops.text:
The arrow means:
not moving along D1.
The entire D1 moves
outward to become D2.

That happens because buyers
now want more at every price:
their demand has increased.
